guidanceConsulted.query: embed cross-origin iframe lazy loading sandbox responsive
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: DO use loading="lazy" for iframes well outside the initial viewport so they do not compete with critical resources.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the below-the-fold showcase iframe carries loading="lazy" and a fixed height (520) so it reserves space and does not shift layout.

guidanceConsulted.query: embed cross-origin iframe lazy loading sandbox responsive
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Referrer Policy: use strict-origin-when-cross-origin as a safe default for cross-origin requests.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: iframe carries referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" plus the house sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" pair (routine Step 6, gendn-kjq).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal overflow narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic <table> with <caption>/<thead>/<tbody>; wrap in an overflow:auto scroller that is keyboard focusable (tabindex=0) with role=region and an accessible name (aria-labelledby the caption).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied to the new compat table: .table-wrap scroller with role=region tabindex=0 aria-labelledby=compat-caption, captioned table with thead/tbody. Exception: sticky headers/stacked card layout not added (3-column, 5-row table; the shared .table-wrap scroller is the house pattern and the page itself has no horizontal overflow at 360px).
